en: Black‑and‑white postcard view of a waterfront terrace built from rounded stones, with deck chairs, potted plants, a large parasol, and low stone walls overlooking a calm bay or fjord. In the distance are low wooded hills and a few boats on the water. An arched stone gateway is visible to the left. Swedish text is printed along the bottom identifying the location and photographer/publisher.
